description: Start instant checkout for one listing. The listing's seller sells the goods. ForthClear runs the marketplace and Stripe processes the payment. Requires sign-in with buyer purchase access. buyer_email is required. quantity must be a positive integer below the listing's quote threshold (quote_quantity_threshold from get_product_details). A threshold of 1 means no quantity can be bought instantly — use request_quote. The listing must have instant checkout and a shipping price. This creates a checkout session; it does not charge the card. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.
